sources.title: LFM2.5-350M: No Size Left Behind | Blog | Liquid AI
sources.snippet: Today, we're releasing LFM2.5-350M, an improved version of our 350M model with additional pre-training (from 10T to 28T tokens) and large-scale reinforcement learning. Built on the LFM2 architecture, it delivers exceptionally fast inference and runs everywhere, from cloud GPUs to cheap CPUs.

sources.title: LFM2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Moving from the LFM2 language backbone to specific applications, we introduce the LFM2-VL (Section 5) and LFM2-Audio (Section 6) multimodal models, covering their design, training, and evaluation, as well as the LFM2-ColBERT-350M model for information retrieval.
